scoring_justification: Cannot recompute spin densities and excitation energies from raw artifacts without running the full DFT pipeline; compare reported values against hidden paper gold with tolerances and trend checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported spin densities and excitation energies as gold references for computed_results.json
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 5 (spin densities) and Table 6 (excitation energies)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the exact numbers reported in the paper for the three complexes, ensuring that a correct reproduction matches them within tolerances.

outputs.description: Computed Mulliken spin densities on the two iron atoms and the lowest TDDFT vertical excitation energy (cm⁻¹) with oscillator strength for the three model radical cations PH3-7d+, 6d+, and CH3O-6e+.

schema.description: tar.gz archive containing expected XYZ files for all neutral and cation complexes.

outputs.description: Archive of DFT-optimized geometries (XYZ format) for the neutral and radical cation states of PH3-7d, 6d, and CH3O-6e. The archive must contain the expected set of files with proper naming.

output_contract.notes: The main scored target is computed_results.json; the geometry archive provides supporting structural evidence. All calculations must use B3LYP functional with LANL2DZ effective core potential on Fe and 6-31G** (geometry) / 6-31+G* (TDDFT) basis sets for other atoms. Spin densities are obtained from Mulliken population analysis.
